# UET GPT — Your AI Guide to UET Taxila

> An intelligent AI assistant that answers any question about UET Taxila using RAG-powered retrieval from official university documents, syllabi, directories, and schedules.

## What is UET GPT?

UET GPT is a specialized AI chatbot for the University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Taxila. It provides fast, accurate answers about admissions, fee structures, academic programs, departments, faculty, campus life, transport routes, hostel allotment, scholarships, examinations, and more.

## Key Features

- **RAG-Powered Answers**: Retrieves information from official UET Taxila documents and web pages
- **Real-Time Data**: Continuously crawls and indexes UET Taxila's official website and admissions portal
- **Multi-Model AI**: Supports Llama 4 Scout (deep reasoning) and Llama 3.1 8B (fast responses)
- **Citation Engine**: Every answer includes source references from official university materials
- **Privacy-First**: Clerk-powered authentication with user-controlled data export and deletion

## Pricing

UET GPT is currently free to use. See full pricing details at https://uet-gpt.vercel.app/pricing.md

## About UET Taxila

The University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Taxila is one of Pakistan's premier engineering institutions, offering undergraduate and graduate programs across engineering, technology, and computer science disciplines. Founded in 1975 (as a campus of UET Lahore, gained independent charter in 1993), it serves over 5,000 students across 30+ programs.

## Technology Stack

UET GPT is built on:
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- **Backend**: Convex (real-time database and serverless functions)
- **Auth**: Clerk
- **AI Models**: Llama 4 Scout (Groq), Llama 3.1 8B (Groq)
- **Vector Search**: Convex vector indexes with Gemini embedding-2
- **Crawler**: Python (curl_cffi, trafilatura)
- **Deployment**: Vercel
